title: [GMCP 203.004.02] Production path: Legacy lifecycle compatibility and governed deprecation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-004-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: GMCP interoperates with pinned older MCP revisions through isolated compatibility adapters for initialize/initialized, ping, legacy HTTP+SSE, resource subscriptions, roots, sampling, elicitation, logging, and legacy task shapes without weakening the modern path. Version selection is deterministic, downgrade is visible, every deprecated feature has telemetry and a tested removal policy, and no legacy state crosses tenant or connection boundaries. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
